title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Launch: Rising Costs and September Plans
description: Reports indicate the iPhone 18 Pro launch involves a significant cost increase and a September release window, according to TrendForce and Bloomberg.

sources.title: iPhone 18 Pro BOM Cost Expected to Surge Nearly 40%, Leaving Apple to Sacrifice Margins to Sustain Shipments, Says TrendForce
Apple Gears Up for September iPhone Launch With Retail Employee Lottery
Key facts: AAPL memory costs squeeze iPhone margins; sues OpenAI

sections.heading: Rising Production Costs
paragraphs: According to TrendForce, the Bill of Materials (BOM) cost for the iPhone 18 Pro is expected to surge nearly 40%. This financial pressure may result in Apple sacrificing its margins to sustain shipment volumes.

sections.heading: September Launch Preparation
paragraphs: Bloomberg reports that Apple is gearing up for a September iPhone launch. As part of the preparation process, the company is implementing a retail employee lottery.

sections.heading: Market and Legal Context
paragraphs: TradingView highlights that memory costs are squeezing iPhone margins. Additionally, the source states that Apple is suing OpenAI.
